messages:
liz: quick sync — finalizing release notes and internal announce for tonight's deploy (18:00 PT). planning to pin runtime to rwd-serve@v2.1.4 and model to 'redwood-base-1.2'. any last-minute blockers?

sam: ACKing the pin. verified perf on staging (p95 latency looks stable). no obvious regressions from my tests.

marco: thanks — running a quick smoke on embed flows now. will flag if anything pops. if we're good, can we lock the RN copy?

liz: locking copy in a few mins. putting the short internal blurb here for quick edit: 

```
Heads up — rolling out 2024.10.2 at 18:00 PT.
What’s included: runtime pin to rwd-serve@v2.1.4, model update to redwood-base-1.2 (minor perf/quality improvements), and a batching optimization that reduces token cost for small requests.
Impact: short canary then gradual rollout; fallback available to rwd-serve@v2.1.3 if we see errors.
Action: No action required unless you own a route; reach out if you need a freeze.
```

aria: tiny nit — call out that embeddings won't change (model variant for embeddings remains redwood-embed-0.8). makes support questions easier.

liz: good call. updated.

deploy-bot: [15:02:15] staging deploy queued: release/2024.10.2 -> rwd-staging (sha: ab12f3c)

deploy-bot: [15:03:02] canary window set: 18:00->18:20 PT, canary traffic 3% -> 25% after 10m if healthy.

sam: ops: any escalation SLAs we should put in the internal note? at least who to ping for rollbacks.

ops-oncall: put me and @marco as primary oncall contact. rollback command is: `deploy-bot rollback release/2024.10.2 --to sha=9f8e7d` (that will revert runtime to v2.1.3 and model to redwood-base-1.1).

marco: copying rollback steps into runbook now. also adding a quick health-check script:

```bash
# quick canary check
curl -sS -X POST https://staging.redwood/api/generate -d '{"prompt":"hello"}' | jq '.latency, .status'
```

liz: nice. I put the internal announce in the company draft channel for copy review. final ask: if anyone expects deploy-time schema migrations or data exports, shout now.

sam: none here. models only.

aria: support queue doc updated with anticipated FAQ lines.

deploy-bot: [15:10:00] preflight checks: model artifacts present: OK; runtime image built: OK; infra quota checks: OK.

liz: sounds like we're green. locking RN and scheduling the public pin note to go out at +5m before deploy. will post rollback steps in the pinned message too. :white_check_mark:

marco: I’ll be on standby at 17:50 PT for canary monitor. if latency > 2x baseline or error rate > 0.5% we rollback.

ops-oncall: acknowledged. will escalate to SRE if rollback needed.

liz: thanks team — final RN locked, internal announce queued. will post here when canary starts.

deploy-bot: [17:59:00] canary traffic flipped to 3% -> started

marco: seeing steady metrics, no spike.

liz: thanks — moving to 25% in 10m per plan.

deploy-bot: [18:10:00] canary health: healthy. traffic increased to 25%.

aria: support aero breathing room. updating live tracker.

liz: excellent. publishing internal announce now and pinning runtime to rwd-serve@v2.1.4 in the console. if anything changes I’ll call it here.

marco: all good from me.

deploy-bot: [18:18:30] rollout: gradual -> 60%

liz: closing thread — thanks everyone. reopen if we need to trigger rollback. :tada:
